items.title: Joseph Daley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 18, 2018
items.q: Similar to people like Paul Robeson and those are the kind of people I kind of emulate when I’m trying to play the instrument.

ctx.x: I just felt like this instrument is directly connected to your inner being.

Yeah well my singing voice is in the same range as the euphonium, and the euphonium is one of those instruments that really really sings out and everything. So when I play, my stylistic way of playing it is to make the instrument really really sing out like a human voice. Similar to people like Paul Robeson and those are the kind of people I kind of emulate when I’m trying to play the instrument. So I don’t really play that as an instrument, similar to Warren, you know I kind of just play it as an extension of my…
Can you remember when you were in let’s say your early teens. What was the music that you would have bought LPs for?
